verdict.rationale: Datadog documents a public REST API for programmatic access to the platform. The docs cover API-key header authentication, official client libraries with per-endpoint code examples, a Postman collection, and an LLM-friendly markdown version of the API reference indexed in llms.txt. missing for 10: an OpenAPI spec at the probed paths (all returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use the Datadog API to access the Datadog platform programmatically.
Authenticate to the API with an [API key](/account_management/api-app-keys/#api-keys) using the header `DD-API-KEY`.
Select one of our official [client libraries](/extend/community/libraries/) languages in each endpoint to see code examples from that library.
A markdown version of this page is available at [https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest.md](https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest.md).
